purpose: Two geographically separated incident transfer cases, without threshold tuning; reference audit precedes scoring.
amendment_reason: The original UTM 15N 2026 search returned only Cypress Creek and Flanders. Flanders has no containment or polygon timestamp, leaving zero eligible new cases. Broaden geography before any new satellite catalogue/pixel inspection; preserve the original search and policy.
geography_reason: CONUS bounding rectangle; native UTM zone derived from each reported origin. Geographic selection is a convenience pilot, not a national probability sample.
eligibility: WF only, unique UUID, not Cypress Creek or a complex child, valid closed-ring polygon, positive discovery and containment times in order, non-null polygon timestamp after discovery and not beyond containment plus 15 days, origin present, full 20 m grid <=400000 cells. Select first two with >=100 km origin separation from Cypress and each earlier selected case. No replacement after imagery/quality results.
reference_policy: Preserve dated source evidence but do not promote WFIGS daily snapshots or attribute timestamps to independent observation times. Scores remain exploratory until target/time evidence is resolved.
independence_limit: Distinct incident UUIDs, separation and non-overlapping geometries are structural screening, not proof of independent fire regimes or reference creation. This is a transfer pilot, not a frozen ML test set.
